name: SIDI BARRANI JASS
description: Swiss Jass variant for four players in fixed partnerships. Each deal starts with an auction to set trump (or Obenabe/Undenufe) and the point target the bidders must make. Play is anticlockwise; declarer leads first. Points from tricks, last trick, Weis and Stöck; first team to 2000 wins.

content.text: Swiss Jass variant for four players in fixed partnerships. Each deal starts with an auction to set trump (or Obenabe/Undenufe) and the point target the bidders must make. Play is anticlockwise; declarer leads first. Points from tricks, last trick, Weis and Stöck; first team to 2000 wins.
Based on Schieber Jass; originated in Swiss armed forces mid-20th century; popular in Central Switzerland and Swiss overseas communities.
Four players in fixed partnerships, partners opposite.
36-card pack (Swiss-German bells, shields, acorns, roses; or French hearts, diamonds, spades, clubs).
First dealer random. Dealer shuffles, left player cuts. Deal all 36 cards anticlockwise in batches of 3, so each player receives 9 cards. Deal rotates right after each hand.

items.text: No Weis or Stöck: Some play without announcing or scoring Weis or Stöck.
Higher minimum bid: Lowest bid 50 or 60 instead of 40.
Bid in steps of 5: Bidding in multiples of 5 (60, 65, 70, …) allowed.
Different target: Play to 1500 or 2500 instead of 2000.
No double or redouble: Some play without doubling; others allow declarer's team to redouble.
